annotations.text: This Software Bill-of-Materials (SBOM) including GitHub Actions document was created on Friday, June 5, 2026 with cdxgen. The data was captured during the build lifecycle phase. The document describes an application named 'github.com/lestrrat-go/jwx/v4'. This SBOM contains 11 GitHub Action references across 8 workflow(s) and 8 job(s). There are 8 workflows including Close stale issues and PRs, Auto-Doc, and Bazel and others. Version pinning breakdown: 8 SHA-pinned, 3 tag-pinned. 7 official and 3 verified action(s) are from trusted sources. Security strengths: 8 action(s) are pinned to specific commit SHAs for maximum security, 3 action(s) are pinned to version tags, 7 action(s) are official GitHub Actions from github.com org, and 3 action(s) are from verified creators. Security considerations: 4 workflow(s) have write permissions to repository resources. Overall, the workflow demonstrates good version pinning practices. 2 package type(s) and 22 purl namespaces are described in the document under components.
